import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_raises_error(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # We use a regex-like approach: 
    # 1. Identify characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    # 2. Replace sequences of these with a single hyphen
    
    import re
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might result in an empty string or just hyphens)
    # If the input was "!!!", re.sub makes it "-", then strip makes it ""
    # If the input was "", it remains ""
    
    return text

import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123 numbers 456"), "123-numbers-456")

    def test_whitespace_and_case(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Mixed Case  "), "mixed-case")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("multiple   spaces"), "multiple-spaces")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("What? (This) is a test."), "what-this-is-a-test")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---hyphens---"), "hyphens")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), "")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")

import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might result in empty string after strip)
    # If the input was "!!!", re.sub makes it "-", and strip("-") makes it ""
    # If the input was " ", strip() makes it "", re.sub makes it "", strip("-") makes it ""
    return text

import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")

    def test_whitespace_and_case(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Multiple   Spaces  "), "multiple-spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("What? (This) is a test."), "what-this-is-a-test")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456_789"), "123-456-789")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  b  "), "a-b")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123 numbers 456"), "123-numbers-456")

    def test_whitespace_and_case(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Extra  Spaces  "), "extra-spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("lowercase"), "lowercase")

    def test_punctuation_and_symbols(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello, World!"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("What? (That's cool)"), "what-thats-cool")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---dash-test---"), "dash-test")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123"), "123")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":

import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 5)
        inv.add("banana", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_count_raises_error(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might become empty after strip/sub)
    # If the original input was empty or only punctuation, the regex might leave it empty
    # or just a single hyphen which is then stripped.
    # Let's check if the result is empty for punctuation-only inputs.
    # Example: "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "-" -> ""
    # Example: "" -> "" -> "" -> "" -> ""
    
    # Special case: if the input was punctuation-only and resulted in a single hyphen, 
    # it's already handled by strip('-').
    # However, if the input was " ", it becomes "" after strip().
    
    # Let's refine: if the input is empty or only punctuation, return empty string.
    # Actually, the regex approach handles most of this. 
    # "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "-" -> ""
    # " " -> "" -> "" -> "" -> ""
    # "a" -> "a" -> "a" -> "a" -> "a"
    
    # One edge case: "a b" -> "a b" -> "a-b" -> "a-b"
    # One edge case: "a...b" -> "a...b" -> "a-b" -> "a-b"
    
    # Let's re-verify "punctuation-only"
    # "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "-" -> "" (Correct)
    # "..." -> "..." -> "-" -> "" (Correct)
    # "   " -> "" -> "" -> "" -> "" (Correct)
    
    return text

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"slugify('Hello World'): {slugify('Hello World')}")
    print(f"slugify('  Python   is   Great  '): {slugify('  Python   is   Great  ')}")
    print(f"slugify('123-456'): {slugify('123-456')}")
    print(f"slugify('!!!'): {slugify('!!!')}")
    print(f"slugify('   '): {slugify('   ')}")

import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might result in an empty string after strip/sub)
    # If the input was punctuation only, e.g., "!!!", re.sub makes it "-", then strip makes it ""
    # If the input was empty, it stays ""
    return text

class Inventory:

### Implementation Plan: Slugify Module

**1. Objective**
Create a robust Python utility to convert strings into URL-friendly "slugs" based on specific character transformations.

**2. File Structure**
*   `slug.py`: Contains the core logic.
*   `test_slug.py`: Contains the unit tests.

**3. Technical Specifications**
*   **`slugify(text)` Logic:**
    1.  **Input Handling:** Accept a string.
    2.  **Whitespace:** Strip all leading/trailing whitespace.
    3.  **Case:** Convert all characters to lowercase.
    4.  **Regex Replacement:** Identify sequences of non-alphanumeric characters (anything outside `a-z`, `0-9`, and spaces) and replace each continuous sequence with a single hyphen `-`.
    5.  **Cleanup:** Strip leading and trailing hyphens.
    6.  **Edge Cases:** If the input is empty or contains only punctuation/whitespace, return an empty string `""`.

**4. Execution Steps**
1.  **Develop `slug.py`**:
    *   Import `re` module.
    *   Define `slugify(text)` function.
    *   Use `re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)` to handle the non-ASCII replacement.
2.  **Develop `test_slug.py`**:
    *   Import `unittest` and the `slugify` function.
    *   Define test cases:
        *   *Normal:* "Hello World" $\rightarrow$ "hello-world"
        *   *Punctuation:* "Hello, World!" $\rightarrow$ "hello-world"
        *   *Multiple Non-ASCII:* "This... is --- a test" $\rightarrow$ "this-is-a-test"
        *   *Empty/Punctuation only:* "!!!", "   ", "" $\rightarrow$ ""
        *   *Leading/Trailing:* "-test-" $\rightarrow$ "test"
3.  **Verification**:
    *   Run `python -m unittest test_slug.py` to ensure 100% pass rate.

**5. Deliverables**
*   Two Python files (`slug.py`, `test_slug.py`).

import re

def slugify(text):
    """
    Convert a string into a URL-friendly slug.
    
    1. Strip leading/trailing whitespace.
    2. Convert to lowercase.
    3. Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen.
    4. Strip leading/trailing hyphens.
    5. Empty or punctuation-only input returns an empty string.
    """
    if not text:
        return ""
    
    # Strip whitespace and lowercase
    text = text.strip().lower()
    
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading and trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    return text

    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen

    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)

import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123 numbers 456"), "123-numbers-456")

    def test_whitespace(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  leading and trailing  "), "leading-and-trailing")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("multiple   spaces"), "multiple-spaces")

    def test_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("MiXeD CaSe"), "mixed-case")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("hello, world!"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("it's a beautiful day"), "its-a-beautiful-day")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---dash-test---"), "dash-test")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("100% success"), "100-success")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a--b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a   b"), "a-b")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

The current implementation of `discounted_price` in `pricing.py` has a logic error: it currently calculates `price * (1 + percent / 100)`, which represents a percentage increase (e.g., 20% more) rather than a discount (e.g., 20% off).

To satisfy the user request:
1. **Logic Fix**: The formula should be changed from `price * (1 + percent / 100)` to `price * (1 - percent / 100)`.
2. **Validation**: Add a check to ensure `percent` is between 0 and 100 (inclusive).
3. **Error Handling**: Raise a `ValueError` if `percent` is outside this range.

**Proposed Fix for `pricing.py`**:
```python
def discounted_price(price, percent):
    if percent < 0 or percent > 100:
        raise ValueError("Percent must be between 0 and 100")
    return price * (1 - percent / 100)
```

- `pricing.py`: Current implementation is `price * (1 + percent / 100)`.
- `test_pricing.py`: The test `assert discounted_price(100, 20) == 80` confirms that the current implementation would fail (it currently returns `120`).

from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):

        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

        inv.add("apple", 0)

        inv = Inventory()

        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()

        inv2.add("apple", 5)

        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 5)

import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    return text

import unittest

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("This is a test..."), "this-is-a-test")

    def test_whitespace_and_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Spaces  "), "spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Mixed Case"), "mixed-case")

    def test_punctuation_and_symbols(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456-789"), "123-456-789")

        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")

        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Spaces  "), "spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Mixed Case"), "mixed-case")

        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456-789"), "123-456-789")

        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")

        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")

import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    return text

import unittest

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

Created `slug.py` with a `slugify` function that:
1. Strips leading and trailing whitespace.
2. Converts the string to lowercase.
3. Replaces any sequence of non-alphanumeric characters (outside ASCII a-z and 0-9) with a single hyphen.
4. Strips leading and trailing hyphens.
5. Returns an empty string for empty or punctuation-only inputs.

Created `test_slug.py` using `unittest` to cover:
- Normal inputs (e.g., "Hello World" -> "hello-world").
- Whitespace and casing (e.g., "  Space  " -> "space").
- Special characters (e.g., "Special @#$%^&*() characters" -> "special-characters").
- Edge cases (e.g., empty strings, punctuation-only strings like "!!!").

Verified the implementation using `python -m unittest discover .`, which passed successfully.

args.content:
import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # This includes punctuation, spaces, and special characters
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might become empty after strip/sub)
    # If the input was "!!!", it becomes "-", then strip("-") makes it ""
    # If the input was " ", it becomes "", then strip("-") makes it ""
    return text

import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("This is a test..."), "this-is-a-test")

    def test_whitespace_and_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Space  "), "space")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Mixed Case Input"), "mixed-case-input")

    def test_special_characters(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Special @#$%^&*() characters"), "special-characters")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456-789"), "123-456-789")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("A_B_C"), "a-b-c")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("12345"), "12345")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   -   "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

The `discounted_price` function in `pricing.py` currently has a logic error: it calculates the price as `price * (1 + percent / 100)`, which actually increases the price (e.g., a 20% discount on 100 results in 120).

To satisfy the user request, the function should be updated to:
1. Subtract the discount: `price * (1 - percent / 100)`.
2. Validate that `percent` is between 0 and 100 (inclusive).
3. Raise a `ValueError` if `percent` is outside this range.

**Proposed Fix for `pricing.py`:**
```python
def discounted_price(price, percent):
    if not (0 <= percent <= 100):
        raise ValueError("Percent must be between 0 and 100")
    return price * (1 - percent / 100)
```

**Verification:**
- **Current state:** `discounted_price(100, 20)` returns `120.0`.
- **Expected state:** `discounted_price(100, 20)` returns `80.0` (matching the test case in `test_pricing.py`).
- **Edge cases:** `discounted_price(100, 0)` returns `100.0`, `discounted_price(100, 100)` returns `0.0`.
- **Error handling:** `discounted_price(100, -1)` or `discounted_price(100, 101)` will now correctly raise a `ValueError`.

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_raises_error(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # We use a regex-like approach: 
    # 1. Identify characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    # 2. Replace sequences of these with a single hyphen
    
    import re
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might result in an empty string or just hyphens)
    # If the input was "!!!", re.sub makes it "-", then strip makes it ""
    # If the input was "", it remains ""
    
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123 numbers 456"), "123-numbers-456")

    def test_whitespace_and_case(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Mixed Case  "), "mixed-case")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("multiple   spaces"), "multiple-spaces")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("What? (This) is a test."), "what-this-is-a-test")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---hyphens---"), "hyphens")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), "")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
","path":"test_slug.py"}

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might result in empty string after strip)
    # If the input was "!!!", re.sub makes it "-", and strip("-") makes it ""
    # If the input was " ", strip() makes it "", re.sub makes it "", strip("-") makes it ""
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # We use a regex to find sequences of non-alphanumeric characters
    import re
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # If the input was empty or punctuation-only, the result might be an empty string
    # (e.g., "!!!" becomes "-", then stripped to "")
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123 numbers 456"), "123-numbers-456")

    def test_whitespace_and_case(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Extra  Spaces  "), "extra-spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("lowercase"), "lowercase")

    def test_punctuation_and_symbols(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello, World!"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("What? (That's cool)"), "what-thats-cool")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---dash-test---"), "dash-test")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123"), "123")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
","path":"test_slug.py"}

    return text

from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 5)
        inv.add("banana", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_count_raises_error(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_counts_raises_error(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
","path":"test_inventory.py"}

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might become empty after strip/sub)
    # If the original input was empty or only punctuation, the regex might leave it empty
    # or just a single hyphen which is then stripped.
    # Let's check if the result is empty for punctuation-only inputs.
    # Example: "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "-" -> ""
    # Example: "" -> "" -> "" -> "" -> ""
    
    # Special case: if the input was punctuation-only and resulted in a single hyphen, 
    # it's already handled by strip('-').
    # However, if the input was " ", it becomes "" after strip().
    
    # Let's refine: if the input is empty or only punctuation, return empty string.
    # Actually, the regex approach handles most of this. 
    # "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "-" -> ""
    # " " -> "" -> "" -> "" -> ""
    # "a" -> "a" -> "a" -> "a" -> "a"
    
    # One edge case: "a b" -> "a b" -> "a-b" -> "a-b"
    # One edge case: "a...b" -> "a...b" -> "a-b" -> "a-b"
    
    # Let's re-verify "punctuation-only"
    # "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "-" -> "" (Correct)
    # "..." -> "..." -> "-" -> "" (Correct)
    # "   " -> "" -> "" -> "" -> "" (Correct)
    
    return text

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"slugify('Hello World'): {slugify('Hello World')}")
    print(f"slugify('  Python   is   Great  '): {slugify('  Python   is   Great  ')}")
    print(f"slugify('123-456'): {slugify('123-456')}")
    print(f"slugify('!!!'): {slugify('!!!')}")
    print(f"slugify('   '): {slugify('   ')}")
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Great"), "python-is-great")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456"), "123-456")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("A quick brown fox"), "a-quick-brown-fox")

    def test_whitespace(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  leading and trailing  "), "leading-and-trailing")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("multiple   spaces"), "multiple-spaces")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello, World!"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("It's a beautiful day."), "its-a-beautiful-day")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---dash-test---"), "dash-test")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("100% success"), "100-success")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a b  "), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    return text

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"slugify('Hello World'): {slugify('Hello World')}")

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might become empty after strip/sub)
    # If the original text was empty or only punctuation, the regex might leave it empty or 
    # result in a single hyphen which gets stripped.
    # Example: "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "!!!" -> "-" -> ""
    # Example: "   " -> "   " -> "   " -> ""
    
    # Re-check for empty string if the input was empty or just punctuation
    # The logic above handles "!!!" -> "" and "   " -> "" correctly.
    # However, " " (single space) -> " " -> " " -> "-" -> ""
    
    # Special case: if the input was empty or only whitespace/punctuation, 
    # and the result is still empty, it's correct.
    # One edge case: "a b" -> "a-b"
    # One edge case: "a...b" -> "a-b"
    
    return text

if __name__ == "__main__":
    print(f"slugify('Hello World'): {slugify('Hello World')}")
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("This is a test_case"), "this-is-a-test-case")

    def test_whitespace_and_casing(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Multiple   Spaces  "), "multiple-spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("lowercase"), "lowercase")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("What? (This) is... amazing!"), "what-this-is-amazing")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456_789"), "123-456-789")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---dash-test---"), "dash-test")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a--b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a   b"), "a-b")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
","path":"test_slug.py"}

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might result in an empty string after strip/sub)
    # If the input was punctuation only, e.g., "!!!", re.sub makes it "-", then strip makes it ""
    # If the input was empty, it stays ""
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123 numbers 456"), "123-numbers-456")

    def test_whitespace_and_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Extra Spaces  "), "extra-spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("What? (This is a test.)"), "what-this-is-a-test")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---multiple---hyphens---"), "multiple-hyphens")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a...b"), "a-b")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_zero_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_negative_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

**Summary of work:**
1.  **inventory.py**: Created an `Inventory` class.
    *   `__init__`: Initializes an empty dictionary.
    *   `add(name, count)`: Adds `count` to the specified `name`. It checks if `count < 0` and raises `ValueError` if so.
    *   `total()`: Returns the sum of all values in the dictionary.
2.  **test_inventory.py**: Created a `unittest` suite covering:
    *   Normal counts (e.g., 10 and 5).
    *   Zero counts (e.g., 0).
    *   Negative counts (verifying `ValueError`).
    *   Instance independence (verifying two separate `Inventory` objects don't affect each other).

**inventory.py**
```python
class Inventory:
    def __init__(self):
        self.items = {}

    def add(self, name, count):
        if count < 0:
            raise ValueError("Count must be a nonnegative integer.")
        self.items[name] = self.items.get(name, 0) + count

    def total(self):
        return sum(self.items.values())
```

**test_inventory.py**
```python
import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    """
    Convert a string into a URL-friendly slug.
    
    1. Strip leading/trailing whitespace.
    2. Convert to lowercase.
    3. Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen.
    4. Strip leading/trailing hyphens.
    5. Empty or punctuation-only input returns an empty string.
    """
    if not text:
        return ""
    
    # Strip whitespace and lowercase
    text = text.strip().lower()
    
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric characters with a single hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading and trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # We use a regex approach to find sequences of non-alphanumeric (non-a-z, non-0-9)
    import re
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # If the input was empty or punctuation-only, it might result in an empty string
    # (e.g., "!!!" -> "-") -> strip("-") -> ""
    # Let's ensure "!!!" returns ""
    if not text and text != "":

        pass
        
    # Re-check for punctuation-only or empty input
    # If the original text was just punctuation, the regex might leave a single hyphen

    # Example: "!!!" -> "- " -> ""
    # Example: "   " -> ""
    
    # Let's refine the logic slightly to ensure "punctuation-only" returns ""
    # The current logic: "!!!" -> "- " -> "" (Correct)
    # "   " -> "" (Correct)

    return text

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123 numbers 456"), "123-numbers-456")

    def test_whitespace(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  leading and trailing  "), "leading-and-trailing")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("multiple   spaces"), "multiple-spaces")

    def test_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("MiXeD CaSe"), "mixed-case")

    def test_punctuation_and_special_chars(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("hello, world!"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("it's a beautiful day"), "its-a-beautiful-day")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---dash-test---"), "dash-test")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("100% success"), "100-success")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a--b"), "a-b")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a   b"), "a-b")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # [^a-z0-9]+ matches one or more characters that are NOT a-z or 0-9
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("This is a test..."), "this-is-a-test")

    def test_whitespace_and_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Spaces  "), "spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Mixed Case"), "mixed-case")

    def test_punctuation_and_symbols(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456-789"), "123-456-789")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), " ") # Wait, let's re-check logic
        # Logic: strip whitespace -> !@#$%^&*() -> lowercase -> !@#$%^&*() -> 
        # replace non-alphanumeric with hyphen -> - -> strip hyphens -> ""
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -a-  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("12345"), "12345")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_strings(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("This is a test..."), "this-is-a-test")

    def test_whitespace_and_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Spaces  "), "spaces")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Mixed Case"), "mixed-case")

    def test_punctuation_and_symbols(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456-789"), "123-456-789")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), " ") # Wait, let's re-check logic
        # Logic: strip whitespace -> !@#$%^&*() -> lowercase -> !@#$%^&*() -> 
        # replace non-alphanumeric with hyphen -> - -> strip hyphens -> ""
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!@#$%^&*()"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("..."), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("a"), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  a  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -a-  "), "a")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("12345"), "12345")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_add_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 10)
        inv.add("banana", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_add_zero_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_add_negative_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import unittest
from inventory import Inventory

class TestInventory(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_counts(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 5)
        inv.add("banana", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 15)

    def test_zero_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        inv.add("apple", 0)
        self.assertEqual(inv.total(), 0)

    def test_negative_count(self):
        inv = Inventory()
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            inv.add("apple", -1)

    def test_independence(self):
        inv1 = Inventory()
        inv2 = Inventory()
        inv1.add("apple", 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 0)
        inv2.add("banana", 10)
        self.assertEqual(inv1.total(), 5)
        self.assertEqual(inv2.total(), 10)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    # Strip whitespace
    text = text.strip()
    # Lowercase
    text = text.lower()
    # Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with one hyphen
    # This includes punctuation, spaces, and special characters
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    # Handle empty or punctuation-only input (which might become empty after strip/sub)
    # If the input was "!!!", it becomes "-", then strip("-") makes it ""
    # If the input was " ", it becomes "", then strip("-") makes it ""
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import unittest
from slug import slugify

class TestSlugify(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_normal_input(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Hello World"), "hello-world")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Python is Awesome!"), "python-is-awesome")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("This is a test..."), "this-is-a-test")

    def test_whitespace_and_lowercase(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  Space  "), "space")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("UPPERCASE"), "uppercase")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Mixed Case Input"), "mixed-case-input")

    def test_special_characters(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify("Special @#$%^&*() characters"), "special-characters")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("123-456-789"), "123-456-789")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("A_B_C"), "a-b-c")

    def test_edge_cases(self):
        self.assertEqual(slugify(""), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("!!!"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("---"), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("  -  "), "")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("12345"), "12345")
        self.assertEqual(slugify("   -   "), "")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    """
    Transforms a string into a URL-friendly slug.
    
    1. Strip leading/trailing whitespace.
    2. Convert to lowercase.
    3. Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with a single hyphen.
    4. Strip leading/trailing hyphens.
    5. Empty or punctuation-only input returns an empty string.
    """
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)
        
    # Strip whitespace and lowercase
    text = text.strip().lower()
    
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric (non a-z, 0-9) with a single hyphen
    # This handles punctuation, spaces, and non-ASCII characters
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    """
    Transforms a string into a URL-friendly slug.
    
    1. Strip leading/trailing whitespace.
    2. Convert to lowercase.
    3. Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with a single hyphen.
    4. Strip leading/trailing hyphens.
    5. Empty or punctuation-only input returns an empty string.
    """
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)
        
    # Strip whitespace and lowercase
    text = text.strip().lower()
    
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric (non a-z, 0-9) with a single hyphen
    # This handles punctuation, spaces, and non-ASCII characters
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}

{"content":"import re

def slugify(text):
    """
    Transforms a string into a URL-friendly slug.
    
    1. Strip leading/trailing whitespace.
    2. Convert to lowercase.
    3. Replace every sequence of characters outside ASCII a-z and 0-9 with a single hyphen.
    4. Strip leading/trailing hyphens.
    5. Empty or punctuation-only input returns an empty string.
    """
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)
        
    # Strip whitespace and lowercase
    text = text.strip().lower()
    
    # Replace sequences of non-alphanumeric (non a-z, 0-9) with a single hyphen
    # This handles punctuation, spaces, and non-ASCII characters
    text = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', text)
    
    # Strip leading/trailing hyphens
    text = text.strip('-')
    
    return text
","path":"slug.py"}
